compound denoting a specific hand-measure; object of the stated suitability
compound qualifying the sugarcane-cubit as fit for every class

items.question: Which alternative cubit-measure is declared suitable for all ritual classes?
premises: Earlier prescriptions assign different cubit-measures according to class rank.
The sugarcane-cubit is presented as an alternative measure.
This sugarcane-cubit is characterized as worthy for all classes.
items.inference: Therefore the sugarcane-cubit may serve as a universally acceptable measure across all classes.
uncertainties: The exact technical definition of kikṣuhasta in this ritual context is not specified in the verse.
items.plain_english: Alternatively, the sugarcane-cubit may be the measure suitable for all classes.
